card.name: Words just before gums, resins, and mouth remedies
card.fires_on: Words such as gum, of, or a comma that come right before a plant gum, resin, spice, or mouth/nose remedy name. Seen in recipes for ink and oil, and in drug-label text on salivation, mouthwash, or decongestants.
